name: Usha Martin Education & Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Usha Martin Education & Solutions Ltd is engaged in educational management services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
UMESL is engaged in providing training to both freshers and professionals across various technical and functional modules of ERP. In addition, the company offers training in e-commerce and CRM software. The company has also initiated training programs for the employees of external corporates, including entitieswithin the same group.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.88 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.04% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.26% over last 3 years.
